recommendations.title: Immediate Relaunch using Top-Performing Assets
recommendations.detail: As there are 0 active campaigns, immediately relaunch by creating a new campaign focused on the 'Xpander GLX AT' model. Use the 'Low DP' (Low Downpayment) hook and the 'LEGIT SURE 100%' creative, which historically achieved a $29.18 cost per message—significantly lower than the recent account average of $78.34.

recommendations.title: Targeting Expansion to Combat High CPMs
recommendations.detail: The recent CPM of $404.44 is exceptionally high. When relaunching, expand the 'Metro South' targeting to include a broader 50km+ radius or use Advantage+ Audience targeting to allow the algorithm to find cheaper inventory. The current high CPC ($12.16) suggests the current audience is too narrow or over-saturated.

recommendations.title: Pivot to Finance-Centric Creative Angles
recommendations.detail: The 'Low DP' ad outperformed others with an 8.22% CTR. For the coming month, produce 3-5 new creative variations focusing specifically on 'Zero Downpayment' or 'Low Monthly Installment' options for other models (e.g., Mirage or Montero) to mirror the success of the top-performing Xpander ad.

recommendations.title: Consolidate Budget into a Single CBO
recommendations.detail: Shift the previous fragmented spend into one Campaign Budget Optimization (CBO) campaign. Use the top-performing 'Metro South | 25–55' segment as the primary ad set but allow for automatic placements to reduce the Cost Per Message from $65.34 down to the historical benchmark of <$30.
